---
title: "Statistics Web Apps"
---

Interactive apps for *Introduction to Statistics and Data Science*. Each one runs
entirely in your browser, so nothing needs to be installed and the first load
takes a few moments.

- [Sampling Distribution Explorer](sap_sampling.qmd) --- draw samples from a
  simulated population of customer ROE values and watch the sampling
  distribution of the sample mean build up.
- [Bootstrap Explorer](sap_bootstrap.qmd) --- resample one real sample of 81
  firms with replacement and see the bootstrap approximation to that same
  sampling distribution.
- [Bagging Explorer](bagging.qmd) --- fit a regression tree to each of many
  resamples and watch the average of the trees settle into a stable curve.
